In which year was the production of scooters in all factories equal to the yearly average number of scooters produced from 1985 to 1989?
solution:
**Given:**

Yearly production data of scooters from 1985 to 1989 in five factories (P, Q, R, S, T).

**Formula used:**

Average production = Total production / Number of years

**Calculation:**

Total production from 1985 to 1989 = 115 + 108 + 149 + 102 + 101

⇒ 575

Number of years = 5

⇒ Average production = 575 / 5

⇒ 115

**∴ The production in 1985 (115) was equal to the yearly average number of scooters produced from 1985 to 1989.**
